title: ONSure Active-Learning Sampling Bias Check v1
description: FR-LEARN-031 Active-learning Sampling Bias: 학습 대상으로 어떤 사례를 선택했는지 selection policy, probability/score, strata, excluded population을 기록한다. uncertainty sampling 등 편향된 표본으로 얻은 효과를 전체 population 성능으로 일반화 금지. A biased (non-representative) selection policy whose effect is claimed to generalize to OVERALL_POPULATION, or excluded_population left undisclosed, is the named negative case.
